text:
sarah_cs: Quick flash async standup — brief notes for the AcmeFin renewal escalation.
sarah_cs: Yesterday — triaged customer reports: partial embedding sets missing for ~18% of requests, saw 500s from embeddings service, escalated to eng.
sarah_cs: Blocker — customers in EU region still seeing failures; renewal call next Tue, need a reliable mitigation before then.
sarah_cs: Today — gather logs, share repro, and try fail-open fallback to cached embeddings.

mike_eng: saw the 500s in Sentry, looks like a memory spike in the embedding worker between 02:10–02:16 UTC. I have a WIP patch to reduce batch sizes.
mike_eng: can you paste a sample request (no PII)? I want to reproduce locally. @devon_se FYI for QA run.

devon_se: pasted a scrubbed sample in thread: `{"user_id":"acct-xxxx","texts":["invoice summary","payment history"]}` — reproduces the 500 for me with current master.

mike_eng: thanks — quick workaround: reduce `MAX_BATCH_TOKENS` to 1024 and restart the embeddings pool. I can push a canary config in Dedicated for AcmeFin.

nate_support: forwarding to AcmeFin contact: they prefer we avoid service interruptions during renewal window. Suggest we enable cache fallback first, then canary the batch-size change.

olivia_pm: noted — timeline: enable fallback today (low risk), canary batch-size change tomorrow morning EU window. I'll update the renewal doc and ping sales.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: `canary/embeddings-batch-size-1024` -> cluster-eu at 2026-03-17T09:05:00Z (ETA 3m). Monitor channel: #eng-sre.

mike_eng: quick command to reproduce locally (scrubbed):
```
curl -X POST https://local-embed:8080/embeddings \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"texts":["invoice summary","payment history"]}'
```

sarah_cs: thanks all — I'll enable cache fallback now and confirm with AcmeFin. If the canary looks stable tomorrow, we propose it as a permanent fix before renewal. :thumbsup:

devon_se: QA will run smoke tests against canary once infra-bot finishes. I'll drop results here.

mike_eng: assigning myself to follow up on heap tuning and a short runbook for on-call. Will post links to the runbook in this thread.

sarah_cs: great — no more blockers from CS side after fallback. Will update renewal notes and share customer-facing message draft later today
